Task success & criterion written before the run by the designer and scored by someone else; terminal predicate held for a 0.5 s dwell; initial conditions matched by image overlay; policies interleaved blind in one session & a rate without a denominator and an interval cannot be compared; the rubric separates a near-miss from inaction; the design is paired, so the count that governs it is paired \\
Robustness & axes that must not change the action and axes that must are scored separately; ranges stated; anchor replayed exactly & the ranking at the anchor is not the ranking under shift; at 40 per arm a fall from 0.50 to 0.30 is a ratio of 0.60 with a 95 percent interval of 0.34 to 1.06, which contains 1 \\
Unseen objects & objects drawn from a stated distribution disjoint from training; bootstrap over objects, not trials & the resampling unit is the object, so trial counts overstate the precision \\
Physical plausibility & dense surface sample against the object mesh or SDF, computed on the policy's own rollouts by code that never entered the reward or the termination rule & a measure the policy optimised is not evidence about the policy \\
Sample and wall-clock cost & counted to that checkpoint, not to the end of training; GPU model and count stated & training variance is not rollout variance and the two are routinely conflated \\
Real-robot transfer & the same 100 initial conditions run in both; correlation on the pairs; variance ratio bootstrapped over the same pairs & a simulator earns a real-world claim only through its measured paired correlation; at 100 pairs \$\textbackslash{}hat\{\textbackslash{}rho\}\$ = 0.70 carries 0.58 to 0.79, enough to say a simulator tracks reality at all and not enough to separate \texttt{suresim\_\allowbreak 2025}'s 0.70 regime from its 0.59 one \\
Reproducibility & diff the paper's stated objective against the released config and name the file and line of every disagreement & 16 of the 62 code-releasing method rows carry a true contradiction between the paper's stated objective and the released code, and 38 carry a recorded disagreement of any kind (\S5.8) \\
